protocol_expansion.reason: Run the monthly contention planner at the same 50-satellite scale as the expanded historical study instead of relying only on the five-target operational smoke campaign.
protocol_expansion.replacement_rule: In deterministic target-pool order, take the first eight candidates outside the frozen historical 50 with a valid current CelesTrak TLE.

protocol_notes.primary_scope: Read-only 50-target shadow validation on public SatNOGS observations; no jobs are submitted.
protocol_notes.station_selection: The same seven connected and available high-volume stations frozen for v4a.
protocol_notes.target_selection: Fifty outcome-blind, count-stratified transmitter targets with a retrievable pre-start CelesTrak TLE.
protocol_notes.weather: Open-Meteo and NOAA forecast bodies are frozen before each solve; terrestrial weather remains evaluation-only unless a predeclared held-out gate supports the optional model.
protocol_notes.space_weather: NOAA SWPC Kp is active when available; missing future intervals stay explicitly missing.
protocol_notes.hardware: Current SatNOGS antenna identities and ranges are hard constraints and their raw station-detail responses are hash-bound; gain/noise stay null without measured declarations.
protocol_notes.causal_boundary: A shadow run tests calibration, robustness and operational scheduling at scale, not causal yield improvement from executed recommendations.
